crossRefs.note: “Woe to you who desire the day of Yahweh! Why do you long for the day of Yahweh? It is darkness, and not light.
All the sinners of my people will die by the sword, who say, ‘Evil won’t overtake nor meet us.’
Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in…
You said, ‘I will be a princess forever,’ so that you didn’t lay these things to your heart, nor did you remember the…
“Come,” say they, “I will get wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and tomorrow will be as today, great…
“Son of man, what is this proverb that you have in the land of Israel, saying, ‘The days are prolonged, and every…
“Son of man, behold, they of the house of Israel say, ‘The vision that he sees is for many days to come, and he…
But if that evil servant should say in his heart, ‘My lord is delaying his coming,’
For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant…
and saying, “Where is the promise of his coming? For, from the day that the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as…
For in an hour such great riches are made desolate.’ Every ship master, and everyone who sails anywhere, and mariners…
Do horses run on the rocky crags? Does one plow there with oxen? But you have turned justice into poison, and the fruit…
For I know how many your offenses, and how great are your sins— you who afflict the just, who take a bribe, and who…
Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?

translations.web: Those who put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near;
translations.bsb: You dismiss the day of calamity and bring near a reign of violence.
